link.title: VR Link
link.fallbackBody: No frames for over {{ms}} ms — the bridge sent latch to hold in place. Following resumes only after a fresh grip press.
link.guardOff: Fallback guard is off: alerts only, no automatic hold
link.rearmHint: Press the right grip again (release → press) to resume following
link.endpointHint: Takes effect immediately and is saved locally; you can set it while the bridge is offline
link.offlineDemoHint: Demo switch: simulates a headset drop to check the offline state
link.offlineDemoHintBridge: Bridge connected — demo switch unavailable (data comes from the real link)

joints.title: Joint Angles
joints.waiting: Waiting for the bridge to report the arm pose…

preview.title: Arm Preview
preview.modelHint: Note: this page currently renders the same URDF as the control page (the studio/SDK one), while the joint angles the bridge reports were solved by metavr against its own model. Joint origins, axes and limits differ between the two, so the pose on screen will not match what metavr believes — a known gap, not bad data.

control.title: Teleop Control
control.estopHint: Sends stop to the follow server and stops forwarding controller frames
control.bridgeHint: These commands go through litearm-vr-bridge to the real link: start / stop / e-stop all affect the arm
control.demoHint: Bridge offline — demo data: these buttons only change page state, nothing is sent to the arm
control.rearmHint: Stopped or e-stopped: press grip again to resume following
control.consoleBusyTitle: The console is driving the arm
control.consoleBusyBody: Console side: {{activity}}. VR teleoperation and the console are mutually exclusive links (they cannot share the same motors) — release the console side before starting VR teleoperation.
control.consoleBusyHint: The console (studio → litearm-server :7449) is driving the arm — the two links are mutually exclusive, so VR teleoperation cannot start from here
control.consoleIdleHint: The console is also connected to litearm-server and currently idle. As soon as it starts moving, the two links become mutually exclusive.
control.consoleOfflineHint: The console is not connected to litearm-server: this page only sees the VR side, so console-side control cannot be judged.
control.conflictTitle: Both links are driving the arm
control.conflictBody: The bridge reports the VR side is following while the console side is also driving the arm. The two links are mutually exclusive — the same motors cannot be commanded by two controllers. Stop one side now and verify the arm state.

events.title: Events & Alerts
events.demoNote: Bridge offline — showing the last events received before it went away

processes.title: Managed Processes
processes.hint: Managed by the bridge from its environment: VR_REPO or METAVR_CMD / FOLLOW_SERVER_CMD
processes.metavrHomeWarning: Starting metavr runs the upstream auto-home: the real arm moves to zero — keep the workspace clear

about.title: What This Page Does
about.view: Watch: whether the headset is streaming, the frame rate, whether the bridge is keeping up, the current arm pose
about.switch: Press: start / stop teleoperation, emergency stop, start / stop managed processes
about.loop: The control loop is not here: controller frames at 90 Hz go through the bridge into metavr for IK, so the console adds no extra hop of latency
about.owner: Ownership is synthesized here: the bridge only sees the VR side (it can only report vr / none), while the console link lives in studio. Only the two together tell who is driving the arm — which is why this page has to stay in the console instead of moving into the bridge
about.noteDemo: Bridge offline — showing local demo data.
